info.name: Project Management System API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Project Management System backend (FastAPI).

**Getting started**
1. Run **Authentication > Login User** (or **Register User** first) — the JWT is automatically saved into `{{jwt_token}}` and used as `Bearer` auth for every other request in this collection.
2. Run **Projects > Create Project** — its id is saved into `{{project_id}}`.
3. Run **Tasks > Create Task** and **Project Members > Add Members To Project** — their ids are saved into `{{task_id}}` and `{{member_id}}` respectively.

**PBAC model** (enforced server-side, see request-level notes):
- **Owner** (`project.created_by`): full control — update/delete the project, manage members, update/delete any task.
- **Member** (active row in `project_members`, or auto-added via task assignment): can view the project, create tasks, and update tasks assigned to them.
- **Assigned User**: can update or (if status is Todo) delete tasks assigned to them, even without being a full project member beforehand (assignment auto-grants membership).

Only endpoints that are actually implemented in the codebase are included — there is no standalone Analytics API (folded into Dashboard) and no standalone Notifications/Email API (email sending is an internal side-effect of the password-reset flow).

variable.description: Base URL of the running FastAPI backend.
JWT access token. Auto-populated by Authentication > Login User (or Register User).
Active project UUID. Auto-populated by Projects > Create Project.
Active task UUID. Auto-populated by Tasks > Create Task.
A user UUID (defaults to the logged-in user; also used as a member-to-add / assignee id).
project_member_id of an existing project member. Auto-populated by Project Members > Add Members To Project.
Short-lived password-reset token. Auto-populated by Password Reset (TOTP) > Verify Reset Code.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Account creation and session management. Login stores the JWT into `{{jwt_token}}` automatically so every other folder can run without manual setup.

header.description: Required for all requests that send a JSON request body.

request.description:
**Use case:** Create a new user account.

Registers a new user, hashes the password (bcrypt), stores the record in `auth.user_master`, and immediately returns a JWT access token so the caller is logged in right after signup.

**Password rules:** min 8 chars, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, and one special character from `!@#$%^&*`.

**Access control:** Public / Unauthenticated.

item.name: Password Reset (TOTP)
item.description: 3-step, stateless, TOTP-based password reset flow (request code -> verify code -> set new password). No reset tokens are ever stored in the database.

header.description: Required for all requests that send a JSON request body.

request.description:
**Use case:** Step 1 of the password-reset flow. Generates a stateless 6-digit TOTP code (valid for a ~30 second window), derived via HMAC from `user_id + current password hash + server secret` — **never persisted to the database** — and emails it to the user via SMTP.

Always returns the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking account existence.

**Access control:** Public / Unauthenticated.

response.name: 200 OK - Code sent (or email not found)

header.description: Required for all requests that send a JSON request body.

Always returns the same generic message regardless of whether the email exists, to avoid leaking account existence.

**Access control:** Public / Unauthenticated.

header.description: Required for all requests that send a JSON request body.

request.description:
**Use case:** Step 2 of the password-reset flow. Verifies the 6-digit TOTP code against the current +/- 30 second window and, if valid, issues a short-lived signed `reset_token` used to authorize the actual password change in Step 3.

This request automatically stores the returned `reset_token` into the collection variable `{{reset_token}}` for the next request.

**Access control:** Public / Unauthenticated.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Unified analytics/telemetry endpoint (pending tasks, task distribution, time-based throughput, productivity insights, recent activity) for the authenticated user's accessible projects and tasks. There is no separate Analytics or Notifications API in this backend — analytics is served entirely from this endpoint, and email is an internal side-effect of the password-reset flow rather than its own API.

request.description:
**Use case:** Single aggregated payload powering the Dashboard/Analytics screen: pending tasks (with urgency), task distribution by project, time-based throughput analytics (7d/30d/90d), productivity insights (today/week/month/YTD), and recently created or updated tasks. All figures are computed live from the caller's accessible projects and tasks — no separate 'Analytics' endpoint exists, this response *is* the analytics data.

**Access control:** Authenticated (any logged-in user); results are scoped to projects the caller owns or is a member of, plus tasks assigned to or created by them.
